reasoning: This is a system status-bar indicator showing cellular signal bars with an error/warning exclamation point. While it can represent troubleshooting mobile reception, signal bars are primarily OS status chrome rather than a concrete task object, and at small sizes it is easily confused with a bar chart or standard signal icon.
